name: Composio
description: Lets a Caisra agent reach the person's apps — Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub and the rest — through Composio, which holds the sign-ins.

baseUrl.description: Where the calls go: the app's local token proxy, which carries the account's sign-in to Claidor's server. The server holds Claidor's Composio key; nothing in the app does.

apiKey.description: Only for talking to Composio directly, in a test. The app never sets it.

userId.description: A placeholder. The server replaces it with the account's own id, so one person's sign-ins are never another's.
